extra_vocab.en: the regular period of time for which a bill is made
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the next billing cycle 指下一個計費週期。自動續訂關閉後，方案從下一期開始就不會再續約或自動扣款。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: billing 是用來修飾 cycle 的名詞，不加 s；billing cycle 是可數名詞，常見 in the current billing cycle、for the next billing cycle。

examples.en: Your invoice will be sent at the end of each billing cycle.
examples.zh: 你的發票會在每個計費週期結束時寄出。

examples.en: You can change your plan before the next billing cycle starts.
examples.zh: 你可以在下一個計費週期開始前更改方案。

examples.en: The current billing cycle ends on the last day of the month.
examples.zh: 目前的計費週期在這個月最後一天結束。

examples.en: Cancel before the billing cycle ends to avoid another charge.
examples.zh: 請在計費週期結束前取消，以免再被收費。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同；billing period 強調一段期間，billing cycle 強調週期性重複。

example.en: The billing period for this plan is thirty days.
example.zh: 這個方案的計費期間是三十天。

similar.diff: payment cycle 側重多久付一次款，常用在公司付供應商的時程。

example.en: Suppliers are paid on a monthly payment cycle.
example.zh: 供應商依每月付款週期收到款項。

confusable.diff: business cycle 是「景氣循環」，指經濟的起伏；billing cycle 是帳單的週期。

example.en: The business cycle affects how much customers spend each year.
example.zh: 景氣循環會影響客戶每年的消費金額。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，a full refund ... has been issued 是現在完成式被動，表示全額退款已經正式開立並撥出。語氣正式，常見於客服通知信。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: issue a refund 的受詞是 refund；改成被動時 refund 變主詞，寫成 a refund has been issued，不要再加受詞。

example.en: The bank issues a new card within five working days.
example.zh: 銀行會在五個工作天內發出新卡。

example.en: Several billing issues were reported by customers last week.
example.zh: 上週有數位客戶回報了幾個帳單問題。

example.en: We are issuing refunds to all affected customers today.
example.zh: 我們今天正在向所有受影響的客戶發放退款。

example.en: The company will issue a refund within ten days.
example.zh: 公司會在十天內發放退款。

example.en: Please issue an invoice in the company's name.
example.zh: 請以公司名義開立發票。

example.en: The receipt was issued by the accounting department.
example.zh: 這張收據是由會計部門開立的。

examples.en: A new invoice was issued yesterday, so please check your inbox.
examples.zh: 新的發票昨天已開立，請查看你的收件匣。

examples.en: The company issued a statement about the delayed shipment.
examples.zh: 公司針對延遲出貨發表了聲明。

examples.en: Refunds are issued to the original payment method.
examples.zh: 退款會退回原本的付款方式。

similar.diff: release 強調把款項、產品或消息放出；issue 強調正式開立或發出文件、款項。

example.en: The finance team released the full payment to the supplier this morning.
example.zh: 財務團隊今天早上已將全額款項撥給供應商。

similar.diff: send out 是較口語的說法，只表示寄出，不強調正式。

example.en: We sent out all the refund notices on Monday.
example.zh: 我們星期一寄出了所有退款通知。

example.en: Keep the receipt in case you need a refund.
example.zh: 請保留收據，以防需要退款。

example.en: Please pay the invoice within thirty days of receiving it.
example.zh: 請在收到發票後三十天內付款。

example.en: You will get a notice when the order is ready.
example.zh: 訂單準備好時你會收到通知。

derived.link: issue + -er，做事的人，像 worker、manager；card issuer 是發卡銀行
issue + -ance，把動作變成名詞，像 assist → assistance

example.en: The company will issue a refund once the form is received.
example.zh: 收到表格後，公司就會發放退款。

example.en: We are working to fix the billing issue today.
example.zh: 我們今天正在處理這個帳單問題。

senses.en: to officially give or send out money or a document

example.en: The bank issued the full refund to your credit card.
example.zh: 銀行已把全額退款退到你的信用卡。

senses.en: to give someone something to use for work
senses.distinguish: 後面接「人」再接物品，或用被動 be issued + 物品時，是配發的意思。

example.en: The IT team issues a laptop to every new employee.
example.zh: 資訊團隊會配發筆電給每位新進員工。

senses.en: to say something officially to the public
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 statement、warning、apology 等話語時，是正式發布。

example.en: The airline issued an apology to passengers after the delay.
example.zh: 航空公司在延誤後向乘客發出道歉聲明。
